identity.name: Bastion Seal
identity.description: While owned, add its listed passive stats. Mana and stamina increase their per-round resource capacity; healing restores health each round, plating reduces each enemy strike, and ward refreshes each round against indirect damage. Only the listed stats are granted.
identity.lore: The gatekeeper left a seal where no stone wall remained.

effects.description: Reduce every ordinary incoming enemy strike before block.
Refresh protection against indirect damage each round.

visual.brief: A heavy square iron seal with cut corners, a bronze bail and a raised pale tower motif over burgundy enamel. Keep the side face substantial.
visual.paletteIntent: Restrained material ramps; no colored rim lighting or isolated glints.
definingFeatures: A heavy square iron seal with cut corners, a bronze bail and a raised pale tower motif over burgundy enamel
